en.text:
Kills release a varying number of Submunitions on top of where the enemy died. 6? second cooldown between activations.

The number of Submunitions spawned is tied to <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Minors: 1 Submunition
• Elites and Players: 3 Submunitions
• Minibosses and Bosses: 7 Submunitions

Submunitions:
• Identical to <yellow Telesto /> Bolts in behavior, exploding on proximity or contact and last up to 10.5 seconds after attaching to a surface.
• Deal up to <pve 39.5? /> <pvp [?] /> damage and inherit the weapon's <link Combatant Damage Scaling [#CombatantScaling] />.
